Configure PaddleOCR language, model tier, and model version

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using System.Text.Json;
using Xberg;

var ConfigOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };
var result = await XbergConverter.ExtractAsync(new ExtractInput { Kind = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ExtractInputKind>("\"uri\"", ConfigOptions)!, MimeType = "image/png", Uri = "https://example.com/images/test_hello_world.png" }, new ExtractionConfig { Ocr = new OcrConfig { Backend = "paddleocr", Enabled = true, Language = new List<string>() { "en" }, PaddleOcrSettings = new PaddleOcrConfig { Language = "en", ModelTier = "mobile", ModelVersion = "pp-ocrv6" } } });
Console.WriteLine(result.Results[0].Content);
```
